hero.name: Md. Ayubur Rahaman
hero.statement: I build and scale digital products through thoughtful engineering, product thinking, and AI. From intuitive web and mobile experiences to reliable backend systems, I turn complex problems into impactful product solutions.

about.label: // about
paragraphs: I'm a Full-Stack Product Engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 6 years of experience building and scaling web and mobile products. I work across the entire product development lifecycle, taking ownership of features from understanding user needs and technical design to implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.

My engineering experience spans frontend, backend, mobile, and cloud infrastructure using React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, React Native, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. I'm particularly interested in building AI-powered products, integrating LLMs, designing RAG pipelines, and developing intelligent agents that solve practical user and business problems.

I believe great product engineering goes beyond writing code. It requires understanding user needs, making thoughtful technical decisions, building maintainable systems, and taking ownership of outcomes. I also contribute to engineering teams through architecture discussions, technical planning, mentoring, and code reviews.

impact: Owned and delivered end-to-end product features across web, mobile, and backend systems using Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, translating product requirements into scalable production-ready solutions.

Designed and implemented end-to-end RAG pipelines using LLMs, vector embeddings, semantic search, and LangChain to power AI-driven customer support and evaluation systems, improving knowledge retrieval and automating workflows for 1K+ users.

Architected event-driven and real-time product capabilities using AWS Lambda, WebSockets, and Redis, supporting up to 10K concurrent connections and asynchronous background processing.
Designed and optimized complex MongoDB aggregation pipelines and PostgreSQL queries to improve application performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Standardized development and deployment workflows by containerizing application services with Docker, improving environment consistency across development and production.
Mentor 12+ junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical discussions while leading technical scoping and implementation planning for 7-person feature teams.
Built reusable, usability-focused UI component patterns adopted across 3 company web properties, reducing new page development time by 20%.
Developed and maintained the organization's Angular-based ERP user interface, supporting 5K+ internal users across departments.
Developed and integrated the company's e-commerce platform using React.js and Next.js, supporting 100K monthly visitors.
Built and shipped a cross-platform mobile application using React Native, delivering customer-facing experiences across iOS and Android.
Developed backend services using PHP and optimized PostgreSQL schemas and queries to support application requirements.
